title: Basic Aggregate Functions
description: Calculate total, average, minimum, and maximum salary using aggregate functions.

data.text: Write a query to calculate the total, average, minimum, and maximum salary across all employees.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS TotalEmployees,
    SUM(Salary) AS TotalSalary,
    AVG(Salary) AS AverageSalary,
    MIN(Salary) AS MinSalary,
    MAX(Salary) AS MaxSalary
FROM Employees;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: Aggregate functions compute a single value from a set of rows. COUNT(*) counts all rows including those with NULLs. SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX ignore NULL values. Use GROUP BY to apply aggregates per group instead of across the whole table.
